User.title: User Profile
User.description: User profile information stored in Firestore keyed by Firebase Auth UID

profilePhoto.description: URL to the user's profile avatar or Google photo

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user profile was initialized

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent authentication session

authProvider.description: Authentication provider method associated with the account

ContactSubmission.title: Contact Submission
ContactSubmission.description: Contact inquiry submitted through the MOMENTA contact form

name.description: Full name of the inquiring person

message.description: Message or vision notes provided by the user

userId.description: Firebase Authentication UID of logged-in user or null for guests

submittedAt.description: Timestamp when the contact inquiry was submitted

phone.description: Phone number provided with the inquiry

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile documents where userId matches the Firebase Authentication UID

/contact_submissions/{submissionId}.description: Stores user and guest contact inquiries submitted to the MOMENTA concierge
